none: PAS NLM-6CF764: Roman Coin: Commemorative Nummus of House of Constantine
contea di ritrovamento: Lincolnshire (Inghilterra e Galles)

Copper alloy. Coin. Nummus of House of Constantine (306-361), Commemorative issue of 330-340, Reece period 17. Obverse description: Helmeted bust of Roma left. Obverse inscription: VRBS ROMA. Reverse description: Wolf suckling twins, two stars above. In exergue: Tr[?P] for Trier mint. Cliff Reeves kindly identified this coin. Diameter: 15.7mm, Weight: 1.86gms, die axis: 1
